name: How long does a landscape installation project usually take?
description: Project duration varies by scope; small projects take days to a week, while larger ones can take weeks to months. Weather and permits also affect the timeline.

mainEntity.name: How long does a landscape installation project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a landscape installation project depends on its scope and complexity. Small projects, such as planting a new garden bed or installing a simple pathway, might take a few days to a week. Larger, more complex installations involving extensive hardscaping, irrigation systems, and multiple design elements can take several weeks to a few months. Factors like weather, material availability, and permit processing times can also influence the timeline. We provide an estimated project schedule during the planning phase.
